AND GOLD HAS ONWARD REACH — it feeds the 'wealth' board of the leaderboard_ranked MATERIALIZED VIEW (5-minute cron refresh) and is market purchasing power, so this is a ranked + tradeable surface, not a cosmetic one. ACCEPTED because the same stipend is reachable honestly in ~3 minutes of play (the forgery buys time, not capability), the live accrual path pays a measured honest max of ~1.05M gold/character-day (~400x this ceiling) so it cannot move a wealth ranking six figures of legitimate income already dominates, and every movement is journalled BY NAME and reversible (goal_claim:/daily_claim: on the payout side, kill_credit_throttled: with claimed_raw on the forgery side). The physics cap (floor(1.3 x elapsed / 600 ms) = 130 kills/min) and the per-day ceiling are FUSES, not the control. Bounty-free adds two clamps the bounty branch does NOT get (so the reviewed money turn-in path is not re-tuned; the asymmetry is harmless because the bounty branch's v_applied is a DELTA against the bestiary counter that falls to zero once the counter sits at baseline+credit, AND because neither ceiling is the control on either branch — 10,000/day is 100x and the physics cap 1,872x the largest target any reader grades (100), so the once-per-period claim guard, which applies identically to both branches, is the real control): the elapsed window is anchored on greatest(last bounty-free credit, player_state.accrued_to) and ceilinged at 10 min — flooring at accrued_to is the CONDITION-2 property, a settle that just ran prices a ~zero window so a credit racing behind it cannot re-stamp the day the span-sim already stamped — and a per-UTC-day ceiling of 10,000 credited kills summed from the append-only hr_kill_credit_log (bounty-free rows only, via a new `free` column). ⚠ THE ACCRUED_TO FLOOR IS ONLY HALF THE SPLIT and the first draft shipped only that half: it stops a credit paying for an already-settled window (settle-then-credit) but NOT the next settle re-covering a window the credit already paid (credit-then-settle), because hr_apply re-simulates [accrued_to, now] in full and has no kill watermark to clamp against. Left additive the daily counter would read settle_sim + observed for ONE set of kills — up to ~1.4x attended truth on the repo’s own measured 60-99% undercount, i.e. a paying goal completing early. CLOSED by the SETTLE-DELTA SUBTRACTION: goalProgressOps writes daily ev:kill_any and lifetime stat ev:kill_any from ONE counter in ONE delta, so the lifetime row’s growth since this character’s previous bounty-free credit IS what the settle put on the daily row; the bounty-free branch records that value on its own log row (new nullable column hr_kill_credit_log.kills_stat) and applies max(0, credit - settle_delta), giving the free branch the same arithmetic cancellation the bounty branch already had against the bestiary counter. No new table, no player_state column, NO EDGE CHANGE (accrual.js untouched, so AWAY-1 parity is untouched by construction). Stated limit: a session MIXING bounty and bounty-free credits over-subtracts (the bounty branch writes the lifetime row too), bounded by one call’s credit and always in the UNDER direction — never a mint.
